# Private Story Reader

Private Story Reader is a free, open-source browser app for reading local documents and listening with browser or operating-system speech voices. Audiobook export can use locally downloaded Piper voices and runs synthesis in browser workers.

## Key facts

- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later.
- Repository: https://github.com/Navaneeth223/link-to-audiobook
- Maintainer contact: navaneethkv.dev@gmail.com
- Local files are parsed in the browser; story text and generated audio are not sent to Piper asset hosts or the reader API during local-file use.
- OneDrive and SharePoint retrieval uses an optional configured server-side Microsoft Graph integration; anonymous public-link resolution is not implemented.
- Browser and operating-system speech voices are used for playback and cannot be exported.

## Features

- In-browser extraction of TXT, Markdown, PDF, DOCX and EPUB documents (40 MB local-file limit; scanned-PDF OCR is not included).
- Chapter navigation, sentence highlighting, search, bookmarks, reading themes and text sizing.
- Piper audiobook export as per-chapter MP3 files in a ZIP, one chapter-marked MP3, or WAV.
- Optional delegated Microsoft Graph retrieval for OneDrive and SharePoint links.
